name: inkstone-design-system
description: Inkstone — 썸네일·영상·숏폼용 차분한 인포그래픽 디자인 시스템

scripts.audit: for f in templates/thumbnail.html templates/video.html templates/shorts.html templates/cases.html templates/motion.html preview.html; do node scripts/render.mjs $f --audit-only || exit 1; done
scripts.render:video: node scripts/render.mjs templates/video.html --video --audit && node scripts/render.mjs templates/video.html --only y1-youtube,y2-youtube --width 1280
scripts.render:all: npm run render:thumbs && npm run render:video && npm run render:shorts && npm run render:cases && npm run render:motion && npm run render:preview
